scanner.title: Scan a barcode
scanner.hint: Place the barcode inside the frame.
scanner.hintContinuous: Scan items one after another. Tap “Done” when you are finished.

invalid.check_digit: The last digit (check digit) does not match. Check the code.
invalid.format: Code not recognised: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A or 4 to 32 characters (letters, digits, - . /).

denied.title: Camera access denied
denied.body: Allow the camera for this site: tap the icon left of the address (padlock, or “aA” on iPhone), then Camera → Allow. Then reload the page. You can also type the code below.

no-camera.title: No camera found
no-camera.body: This device has no usable camera. Type the code below, or use a barcode scanner.

in-use.title: Camera already in use
in-use.body: Another app is using the camera. Close it and try again, or type the code below.

unsupported.title: Camera not available here
unsupported.body: The browser only allows the camera on a secure page (https). Type the code below, or use a barcode scanner.

unknown.title: The camera could not start
unknown.body: Try again, or type the code below.

sale.scanAria: Scan a barcode to add an item
sale.maxReached: {{name}}: all the stock is already in the cart
sale.lookupFailed: The code lookup failed. Check the connection and try again.
sale.createdAndAdded: {{name}} created and added to the cart

stock.addByBarcodeAria: Scan a barcode to open or create a product
stock.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {# barcode will be created} other {# barcodes will be created}} (internal EAN-13 starting with 2). Existing codes are never changed.
stock.confirmNone: Every product already has a barcode.
stock.generated: {count, plural, =0 {No code created} one {# barcode created} other {# barcodes created}}
stock.generateFailed: The codes could not be generated. Try again.

field.label: Barcode
field.hint: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A or internal code. Unique in your shop.
field.willGenerate: An internal barcode will be created when you save.

detail.title: Barcode
detail.generateFailed: The barcode could not be created. Try again.
detail.variantsMissing: {count, plural, one {# variant without a code} other {# variants without a code}}

label.title: Print label
label.printed: {count, plural, one {Label sent to the printer} other {# labels sent to the printer}}
label.printFailed: Printing failed. Check the printer is on, then try again.
label.notConnectedBody: Connect the Bluetooth receipt printer to print the label.
label.shareHelp: This browser cannot talk to the printer directly: share the label as an image to the printer's app (or AirPrint).
label.fallbackHint: Press and hold the image to save or share it.

settings.barcodeModeHelp: If the label comes out without bars or with odd characters, choose “Image”: the barcode is then drawn and printed as a picture.
